summary: Walker & Dunlop, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, reporting that on September 9, 2026 it amended its Master Repurchase Agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. The ninth amendment extends the termination date to September 9, 2027, and a Third Amended and Restated Side Letter updates fees, commitments and pricing; the parent continues to guarantee the operating subsidiary's obligations. No equity, ownership, price-per-share or premium terms are implicated. This is routine financing documentation, not a special situation; watch only refinancing and covenant risk.
